newsitem.title: CANADA: Shaw renegotiates syndicated bank loan.
newsitem.headline: Shaw renegotiates syndicated bank loan.

text.p: Shaw Communications Inc said on Tuesday it renegotiated its syndicated bank credit facilities in a move aimed at providing more flexibility and lower costs.
Shaw's credit facilities total more than C$1 billion and consist of C$500 million in revolving facilities and C$500 million in term loans.
The company said the amendment gave it greater flexibility in providing customers with the most value and choice of entertainment and information services.
The syndicate includes domestic and foreign banks that chose to renew or increase their lending levels, resulting in a large oversubscription, Shaw said.
It said Toronto-Dominion Bank would continue as agent and issuing lender.
